records.name: Mineralbad Leuze
records.description: Large thermal pool and wellness centre with mixed visitors. Older forum comments make inconsistent claims of male encounters in saunas and pools; the last March 2024 firsthand review said no encounters observed. The official site confirms the operating facility, NOT sanctioned sexual activity, and notes temporary shower-section maintenance on 2–6 and 9–13 November 2026.

The old gay directory describes discreet cruising, but the newest specific forum story is from 2018 and nothing since proves activity. The current operator confirms standard winter opening and several separate areas that may temporarily close.
